test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: **What is the connection between the prize winners and the famous Indian mathematical genius Ramanujan?**

options.text: They solved questions on Ramanujan's graphs that had not been solved for a long time.
They explained Ramanujan's graphs in solving the Kadison-Singer problem.
The prize winners were all students of Ramanujan.
The prize winners were all admirers of Ramanujan's great contribution.

solution:
The correct answer is: **They solved questions on Ramanujan's graphs that had not been solved for a long time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The connection between the prize winners and the famous Indian mathematical genius Ramanujan is that they solved questions on Ramanujan's graphs that had not been solved for a long time.
 
• The first sentence in the second paragraph of the given passage states that,
 
 
• *"**Marcus, Spielman and Srivastava__ __solved longstanding questions on the Kadison-Singer problem and on Ramanujan graphs__**,..."*
 
 
 
• ​From here we can conclude that the correct answer is **option 1.**
